# Accuracy analysis: c-protocolbuffers-protobuf-this-must-be-autogenerated

Measured 2026-10-13 on main 3f7c2b64 (`benchmark_optimal_solutions`, `painting_failure_census`,
`mismatch_detail_for_fixture`, `painting_disagreement_detail`). The engine changes; re-measure
before relying on these numbers.

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Mapping mismatches | 27 (27 visible) of 9010 nodes, 9009 graded, N:M floor 0 visible |
| Painting, Minimal | 1225 bytes wrong of 38104: renderer 580, matcher 717 |
| Painting, Full | 1607 bytes wrong of 38104: renderer 1185, matcher 468 |
| Ground-truth invariant violations | 8 (lines 122-123 `UPB_DESC(...)` call; a gap on line 144) |

## The change

protobuf `upb/reflection/def_pool.c`: every `UPB_DESC(X)` macro use is replaced by the expanded
name `google_protobuf_X`. Some sites are `UPB_DESC(X) *` in a type, some are `UPB_DESC(X_fn)(args)`
calls, and some are `UPB_DESC(EDITION_UNKNOWN)`. clang-format then rewraps several of the
affected lines. description.md says that line 454, `UPB_DESC(FileDescriptorProto) * file;`, is
misparsed: it should be a declaration, but tree-sitter parses it as an expression statement (a
multiplication). The parse has no ERROR node.

## Mapping

### Macro name instead of its argument paired with the new identifier (26 visible)

This happens at 13 sites, on lines 48, 113, 122 (twice), 143, 146, 150, 381, 393, 409, 411, 443,
454 and 470. The ground truth deletes `UPB_DESC` and pairs the macro argument with the new name:
`FeatureSetDefaults` -> `google_protobuf_FeatureSetDefaults` (Update), and
`FileDescriptorProto_name` -> `google_protobuf_FileDescriptorProto_name`. omnidiff does the
reverse at every site with `APTED("qualified_name")`. It maps `UPB_DESC` to the new identifier
(MatchButNotIdentical or Update) and deletes the argument. For `UPB_DESC(EDITION_UNKNOWN)`
(lines 146 and 150) it deletes `EDITION_UNKNOWN`. In `apted/common.rs`, `UnitCostModel::ren`
gives every differing leaf text the same `COST_UPDATE`. So "UPB_DESC -> google_protobuf_X" and
"X -> google_protobuf_X" cost the same. At every site omnidiff ends up with the leftmost leaf,
`UPB_DESC` (I did not trace the tie-break). The ground
truth is plainly the better reading, because the new name contains the argument verbatim.
`matcher`.

### Misparsed declaration on line 454 (1 visible)

Before line 454, `UPB_DESC(FileDescriptorProto) * file;`, parses as
`expression_statement > binary_expression`. After line 452, `google_protobuf_FileDescriptorProto*
file;`, parses as a `declaration`. The ground truth pairs the `*` of the multiplication with the
`*` of the `pointer_declarator` (Identical). omnidiff deletes it, because the two parents differ in
kind. The two other mismatches on this line (`UPB_DESC` and `FileDescriptorProto`) belong to the
group above. `parse-error` (a misparse, not an ERROR node).

## Painting

### Matcher-caused (Minimal about 677 bytes, Full about 425)

These runs follow from the swap above and go away with the human mapping.

- Before side, both presets: `UPB_DESC` is painted Update where the paintings have Delete. There
  are 11 sites, 88 bytes.
- Before side: the macro argument (`FeatureSetDefaults`, `FileDescriptorProto_parse_ex`, ...) is
  painted Delete. The Minimal painting leaves it unpainted, because the argument survives inside
  the new name. That is 263 bytes, plus 30 for `EDITION_UNKNOWN` and 2 for ` *` on line 454. The
  Full painting paints it Update: 245 bytes, plus 30.
- After side, Minimal: the whole new identifier is painted Update, because omnidiff pairs it with
  `UPB_DESC` and the two share no text. The painting inserts only `google_protobuf_` and leaves
  the rest unpainted: 264 bytes. The two `google_protobuf_EDITION_UNKNOWN` (after lines 145 and
  149) get Insert on `EDITION_UNKNOWN` where the painting has nothing: 30 bytes.
- After side, Full: the two `google_protobuf_EDITION_UNKNOWN` are painted Insert, where the
  painting has Update from `EDITION_UNKNOWN`: 62 bytes.

### Renderer-caused (still present with the human mapping)

- Minimal, Update -> Insert, 272 bytes. The added prefix `google_protobuf_` of each renamed
  identifier (17 sites) is labelled Update by the narrowed update. The Minimal painting labels it
  Insert. This is a label convention for a pure prefix insertion inside an updated leaf.
  `renderer`.
- Minimal, Move -> None, 235 bytes. Unchanged text that clang-format rewrapped onto another row
  or column is painted Move: `* const* default_list` and `(defaults, &size)` on lines 144-145;
  `(default_list[i])`; `upb_DefPool* s`, `const`, `*` and `file_proto` in the
  `upb_DefPool_AddFile` signature (lines 442-444); the arguments of the
  `FeatureSetDefaults_parse` call (after line 123). The painting treats reflow as no change.
  `renderer`.
- Full, Move -> None, 996 bytes. Whole unchanged blocks and argument lists are painted Move. Their
  first row was pushed right by the longer identifier, on a row whose index shifted because lines
  above were joined: the `if (edition == ...) { ... }` body (lines 150-153), the
  `(builder->tmp_arena))) { ... }` block (393-395), the `upb_DefPool_AddFile` parameter tail and
  body (444-447), and the `(init->descriptor.data, ...)` arguments (470-472). In
  `text.rs::identical_or_move`, the exemption `displaced_beside_an_edit_on_its_first_row` only
  applies when `paint_displaced_moves` is off, which is Minimal. Under Full, a multi-row node
  must keep its row index to count as merely shifted, so these nodes get Move. The Full painting
  leaves them unpainted. `renderer`.
- Full, None -> Delete, 44 bytes. The painting deletes the space in `UPB_DESC(X) *` (lines 381,
  409, 443 and 454) and paints what follows. The renderer leaves it unpainted. Full, None -> Move
  and None -> Insert, 23 bytes: the painting paints the indentation and ` =` of the rewrapped
  `default_list` declaration (lines 144-149), and the renderer does not. `renderer`.

### Painting-caused (both presets)

Minimal 73 bytes, Full 122. On before lines 122-123, `const UPB_DESC(FeatureSetDefaults)* defaults
= UPB_DESC(FeatureSetDefaults_parse)(...)`, both paintings leave the second `UPB_DESC(` and the
`FeatureSetDefaults_parse` -> `google_protobuf_FeatureSetDefaults_parse` rename unpainted on both
sides. The human mapping says these nodes are deleted and updated. invariants.txt flags this as
[11] (removed `UPB_DESC` unpainted at line 122 col 49) and [12] (edited leaf painted on neither
side), for both paintings, and [16]. The other `UPB_DESC(X_fn)(...)` call sites are painted. This
one looks like a missed selection. `ground-truth`.

## Verdict

- Primary cause: `matcher` (it owns 26 of 27 visible mismatches and most of Minimal's bytes. Full's
  larger renderer share is displaced-block Move, a separate issue).
- Other causes: `renderer`, `ground-truth`, `parse-error`
- Where a fix would go: the leaf-pairing tie in `apted::for_nodes` (`UnitCostModel::ren` is
  text-blind, so `UPB_DESC` and the macro argument tie for the new identifier). Prefer the leaf
  whose text the new text contains. For Full, the row-index condition in
  `text.rs::identical_or_move`. For Minimal, the Update/Insert label of a pure prefix insertion.
- Ground truth questionable: yes: both paintings leave the `UPB_DESC(FeatureSetDefaults_parse)`
  call on lines 122-123 unpainted, against the human mapping and against every other call site
  (invariants [11], [12], [16]).
